extension_description.message: Export your Google Scholar PDF Reader annotations (highlights and notes) to a JSON, CSV, LaTeX or Markdown file.

stop_exporting_title.description: Tooltip for the button to stop exporting

export_all_pages.description: Button text to export all pages

export_all_pages_title.message: Automatically navigate to the first page and export the annotations from all the pages in sequence, navigating to the next page after each export. This may take a while if you have many pages.
export_all_pages_title.description: Tooltip for the button to export all pages

export_selected.description: Button text to export selected papers

export_selected_title.message: Export the annotations from the selected papers on the current page to a file
export_selected_title.description: Tooltip for the button to export selected papers

export_stopped.description: Alert message when auto-export is stopped

export_all_confirmation.message: This will automatically navigate to page 1 and export all pages in sequence. Start?
export_all_confirmation.description: Confirmation message when exporting all pages

export_stop_confirmation.message: Are you sure you want to stop the auto-export?

export_no_template.message: No custom export template is set. Please set one in the advanced options.
export_no_template.description: Alert message when no custom export template is set

select_all.description: Button text to select all papers

select_all_title.message: Select all papers on the current page
select_all_title.description: Tooltip for the button to select all papers

deselect_all.description: Button text to deselect all papers

deselect_all_title.message: Deselect all papers on the current page
deselect_all_title.description: Tooltip for the button to deselect all papers

reset.description: Button text to reset everything to default

reset_title.message: Reset all settings to default and deselect all papers on the current page. Can be used to recover from an invalid state (e.g., after a breaking change in the extension).
reset_title.description: Tooltip for the button to reset everything to default

fetch_context.description: Label for the checkbox to fetch context

fetch_context_title.message: Include the entire sentence in which the highlight is found, to provide better context. This may not be available for all highlights, and will slow down the export.
fetch_context_title.description: Tooltip for the checkbox to fetch context

export_as_title.message: Select the format in which to export the annotations
export_as_title.description: Tooltip for the label of export format selection

citation_style_title.message: Select the citation style for the exported annotations
citation_style_title.description: Tooltip for the label of citation style selection

advanced_options.description: Button text to open advanced export options

advanced_options_title.description: Tooltip for the advanced options button

advanced_options_help.message: Use a custom Handlebars template to control the export output. The list of available fields can be found here, alongside the default templates.
advanced_options_help.description: Helper text shown in the advanced options modal

custom_template.description: Label for the custom export template textarea

custom_template_placeholder.description: Placeholder text for the custom export template textarea

save.description: Button text to save advanced options

cancel.description: Button text to cancel advanced options changes

collect_error_generic.message: An error occurred during the export process. Please check the console for details.
collect_error_generic.description: Alert message when an error occurs during export

collect_error_no_papers_selected.message: Please select at least one paper.
collect_error_no_papers_selected.description: Alert message when no papers are selected for export

collect_error_captcha.message: Google Scholar requested a CAPTCHA. Please solve it on the page and then refresh to resume.
collect_error_captcha.description: Alert message when Google Scholar requests a CAPTCHA

status_exporting.description: Status message when papers are being exported

status_captcha.message: STOPPED: CAPTCHA Detected! Please solve it and refresh the page.
status_captcha.description: Status message when CAPTCHA is detected

status_next_page.description: Status message when moving to the next page

status_exported.description: Status message when papers are exported

untitled_paper.description: Default title for papers without a title
